notes: WhatsApp uses a local brand mark; scale and barcode use purpose-built local SVGs to preserve their meaning across icon styles.
Data Cleaning uses the 20px Fluent System Broom Sparkle resource; SVG viewBox is preserved when displayed at app scale.
Turnos, Sueldos, Gestión RRHH and Reportes de Personal use purpose-built local SVGs in every family (no upstream Fluent Emoji matches them).
Las apps del catálogo DOLAN_app_catalog usan glifos propios (scripts/app_catalog_glyphs.py) generados en las cinco familias por scripts/build_app_catalog.py.
